title: Chairil Anwar's birth chart
metaDescription: Chairil Anwar's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 2.4° Leo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 2.4° Leo, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 2.4° Leo — deep enough in the first decan (0°–10°) that the Sun, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 19.2° Cancer, Venus was at 12.8° Virgo, Mars was at 11.7° Sagittarius. Read together: thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that grows by reliability; effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Venus to Uranus, a opposition with 0.3° of slack. An opposition puts two needs on opposite shores of the same water. Neither drowns; neither gets the whole beach. Behind it, the Sun sextile Saturn at 0.6°, and Mars sextile Jupiter at 0.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: Venus opposes Uranus while both square Mars. The t-square is the figure the old texts trusted for output: friction with a fixed address. The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags three placements in this chart. The Sun in Leo at 2.4° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Venus in Virgo at 12.8° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Saturn in Libra at 3.0° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Counting only the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the chart runs 3 fire, 3 water, 2 air, 1 earth by element and 4 cardinal, 3 mutable, 2 fixed by modality. Uranus was retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Leo into Virgo during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.8° between one midnight and the next. Half the day belongs to each sign, and the split falls at an unrecorded hour — so this page holds the Moon as a genuine unknown.
